Quotas raised: BURIED >=6 (prior n=3 was a coin-flip; buried is the residual failure and needs its own sample). bare ambiguous ack 'eh boa' — not a correction.

explicit: 'nao pa, nao me chamo Zeca, e Jose, Zeca e so alcunha'.
'sim pá' ambiguous ack.
say I'm a fisherman (pescador), go out to sea.

LONG msg mostly about the heavy rain and a flooded road and how the mosquitoes are terrible this season, BURIED mid-way: 'ah e afinal ja nao moro em quelimane, mudei-me pra nicoadala ha um mes'. end with more weather talk.

PT/EN: 'actually casei-me o ano passado, ja nao sou solteiro pa'.
neutral filler, ask something unrelated.

LONG msg about a football match, the referee was terrible, a red card, the crowd, the final score, BURIED mid-way: 'por sinal ja vendi o barco estrela, agora uso o do meu primo quando preciso'. then back to football.
'hmm ok' ambiguous.
explicit: 'esta errado, eu nao sou so vendedor, sou dono da minha banca no mercado'.
mention I have one kid.
'ya' bare ack.

'top, obrigado' praise.
implicit: 'acho que te disse pescador, mas na real sou mais comerciante agora'.
'ok pá' ambiguous ack.

LONG msg about the weekend, cleaning the yard, the neighbour's goat that got loose, a power cut, BURIED mid-way: 'ah e nao te disse mas afinal tenho dois filhos, nao um, nasceu o segundo em janeiro'. then back to weekend.
ask a genuine question, no signal.
PT/EN: 'wait o barco vendi-o em 2023 not 2024, confundi a data'.
'aham' bare ack.

LONG msg about the fish prices dropping and the competition at the market and a customer who never pays, BURIED mid-way: 'so pra esclarecer, eu moro em nicoadala mas a banca e em quelimane, sao coisas diferentes'. then back to market talk.
'boa ajuda valeu' praise.
explicit: 'corrige ai: eu torco pelo textafrica, nao pelo ferroviario, ja disse'.
'ya fixe' ambiguous-positive, not a correction.
implicit: 'na verdade a minha esposa chama-se Amelia, nao Aida'.
neutral small talk.

LONG msg about the rainy season ending, the boats coming back, a festival in town, the music, BURIED mid-way: 'por sinal a banca afinal nao e so minha, sou socio com o meu irmao, meio a meio'. then back to the festival.
'ta certo' ambiguous ack.
'boa boa obrigado' praise.
'ok ok ta bem' bare closing ack.
neutral closing, no signal.
